logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "tool.start", correlationId: vars.traceId, tool: vars.toolName, mode: p("data.mode")}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "tool.success", correlationId: vars.traceId, tool: vars.toolName, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.startedAt}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {success: true, correlationId: vars.traceId, mode: p("data.mode"), data: payload}]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "tool.failure", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, tool: vars.toolName default "unknown", category: vars.publicError.category, code: vars.publicError.code, retryable: vars.publicError.retryable, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - (vars.startedAt default (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}))}, "application/json", {indent: false})]
